zecliptic.why: Sol's equator. The rule: everything from the Zecliptic unless a frame is named with a reason.

ecliptic.why: Earth's orbit plane. Named here only because the ephemeris is tabulated in it.

invariable.why: The system's total angular-momentum plane (Souami & Souchay 2012). Set by Jupiter and Saturn.

sol.name: Sol
sol.rot_note: sidereal, equator; 25.38 d Carrington; ~34 d near poles (differential)
sol.notes: Holds 99.86% of system mass but only ~0.5% of its angular momentum.

mercury.name: Mercury
mercury.notes: Spin:orbit = 3:2 exactly (58.646 d x 1.5 = 87.969 d). GM known to 1e-6 from MESSENGER. Mariner 10 'moon' (1974) was the star 31 Crateris. No satellite found by MESSENGER 2011-15.

venus.name: Venus
venus.notes: Retrograde spin; solar day 116.75 d. Node 76.68 deg is within 1 deg of the solar equator node 75.76 deg.

earth.name: Earth
earth.notes: Defines the ecliptic. Earth-Luna barycenter 4671 km from Earth center (0.733 R_E, inside).

mars.name: Mars
mars.notes: Crustal remanent field only. Phobos inside synchronous orbit (decaying ~1.8 m/cy); Deimos outside.

jupiter.name: Jupiter
jupiter.notes: Radiates 1.67x the sunlight it receives. System III rotation 9h 55m 29.7s. Galilean moons 1:2:4 Laplace resonance (Io:Europa:Ganymede).

saturn.name: Saturn
saturn.notes: Rings lie in the equatorial plane, tilted 26.73 deg to the orbit; ring-plane crossings every ~15 yr (next 2025 Mar 23, 2038-39). Ring mass / Saturn mass = 2.7e-8.

uranus.name: Uranus
uranus.notes: Node 74.006 deg is 1.75 deg from the solar-equator node (75.76 deg). Rolls on its side; ring plane = equatorial plane at 97.77 deg. Equinox 2007 Dec 7; next 2049.

neptune.name: Neptune
neptune.notes: Radiates 2.61x received sunlight. Triton retrograde (i=157 deg) = captured KBO; Triton is 99.5% of Neptune's moon mass.

pluto.name: Pluto
pluto.notes: Pluto and Charon are mutually tidally locked (both 6.3872 d). Barycenter 2,126 km from Pluto center = 1.79 R_P, OUTSIDE Pluto. 3:2 resonance with Neptune (2 Pluto orbits = 3 Neptune orbits).

luna.name: Luna
luna.phase_note: Luna: Meeus series (real). Others: circular, period-exact, epoch-arbitrary phase.
luna.notes: Synchronous rotation. Recession 3.8 cm/yr (LLR). Mass ratio to Earth 0.01230.

phobos.phase_note: Luna: Meeus series (real). Others: circular, period-exact, epoch-arbitrary phase.
phobos.notes: Orbits faster than Mars rotates: rises in the west.

belt.sample_note: 600 representative main-belt orbits, seeded, Kirkwood gaps carved; NOT real objects

heliobarrier.name: Heliobarrier (HB)
heliobarrier.notes: Not a sphere: a blunt nose toward (lambda 255.7, beta +5.1) with a tail downwind. The IBEX ribbon is a ~20 deg wide band of ENA emission, a 3-D structure on the HB.

pis.definition: Pis = (orbits per year, counted against the stars) x pi. Frame of the year is declared per row.

events.label: Solar equinox, B0 = 0 (Earth on Sol's equator node line)
